positioning_dataset.unchanged_file_scope: Acquisition plan and all planned records, ZIPs and checksums.

limits: Current archive versions can contain revisions not observed historically.
UTC interpretation and publication before decision are explicit retrospective assumptions.
positioning_quality.snapshot_lag: Monday cutoff uses prior Friday plus one/four-week earlier Fridays.

limits: Assumes the published general settlement rule applied without an exceptional override.
Index candle extrema must cover the settlement rule's secondwise samples.
A bounded accounting scenario is not an observed settlement transaction.
settlement_evidence.method: Bounds on equally weighted 1800-second index average from 30 one-minute OHLC ranges.

limits: Funding publication by 01:00 and positioning publication are retrospective assumptions.
Archive revisions can differ from historically available information.
Only midnight funding events and a 02:00-to-02:00 holding horizon are tested.
Reused history and repeated experiments do not constitute untouched confirmation.
Forecast labels are gross beta-hedged price returns, not calibrated net profit or probabilities.
A three-payment adverse funding hurdle is an estimate; actual future funding is accounted separately.
Missing future labels exclude whole training dates but do not suppress current forecasts.
Hourly fills, cost assumptions and margin heuristics cannot prove executable account outcomes.
A portfolio trailing rule cannot guarantee a ten-percent maximum drawdown.

design.label: (asset 02:00-to-next-day-02:00 price return - beta_ratio * BTC return) / (1 + abs(beta_ratio))

design.prediction_centering: None; BTC synthetic hedge prediction is zero.
design.training: Expanding; labels end strictly before UTC 01:00 decision; first eligible monthly refit.
